name: sem_full
summary: The bounded dispatch queue was full, so the turn was shed rather than queued.
trigger: Acquiring a dispatch slot failed because every in-flight slot was taken.
grounding: Transport: it requires a bounded concurrent dispatch queue to exist. This is backpressure — the capture path shedding load to avoid becoming the reason the request path is slow — and its correct value is a property of one deployment's capacity, not of what a turn is. An implementation that writes turns synchronously has no such queue and can never emit it.
not_expressible: Queue saturation is runtime state, not data.
notes: The one drop reason that means the turn was fine and the capture path was not. It is the counter to read before concluding that traffic changed.
